source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
completion:
Begin the database at the date you want to find the evidence of the emissions.
3. Check the emissions conditions in section 10 of the latest project license.
4. Record “e” for an emission and “i” for an incident of excessive emissions.
5. Use the monitor names to make sure the numbers being recorded are the ones you want.
6. Look at the data for a whole year around the weather system dates or other variations to find out what occurs naturally vs. due to circumstances at the site.
7. Then compare to all the evidence available.
8. Make a report.
